### Key Evidence Map — 5B Lens Coverage

| Lens | Primary Chunks | Evidence Weight |
|---|---|---|
| **5B.1** (broad-based prosperity vs. rents) | U0005, U0006, U0021, U0030, U0031, U0042, U0046, U0048, U0062, U0063, U0065 | **Medium** — campaign/platform positions; biography ends at presidency threshold |
| **5B.2** (qualified appointments, independence) | — | **Not covered** — no evidence on economic professional appointments in this source |
| **5B.3** (fiscal/monetary/debt rules, stability) | U0005, U0006, U0029, U0030, U0035, U0040, U0042, U0044, U0046, U0047, U0062 | **Medium** — energy sovereignty, FOBAPROA critique, austerity pledges; opposition-framed for pre-presidency period |
| **5B.4** (fair competition/regulatory framework) | U0006, U0035, U0044, U0046, U0047 | **Low-medium** — energy sector privatisation opposition is primary evidence |
| **5B.5** (anti-corruption enforcement) | U0017, U0023, U0027, U0029, U0030, U0034, U0040, U0045, U0046, U0061, U0064 | **Medium** — FOBAPROA/FOBAPROA, anti-corruption pledges; gap evidence from non-remedying (U0027) and conspiracy framing (U0023) |
| **5B.6** (budget quality/execution) | U0021, U0031, U0046, U0048, U0062, U0063 | **Low-medium** — social programs, universal pension, infrastructure; opposition allegation of patronage |
| **5B.7** (reliable information, audit, correction) | U0023, U0027, U0045, U0046, U0061 | **Low-medium** — conspiracy/scapegoating framing in U0023; anti-corruption/audit commitments elsewhere |
| **5B.8** (fair distribution across classes/regions/genders) | U0005, U0021, U0031, U0046, U0048, U0062, U0065 | **Medium** — "pension universal," social programs for vulnerable groups, "primero los pobres," minimum wage commitments |
| **5B.9** (shock response) | U0005, U0057, U0062 | **Low** — opposition critique of EPN-era price shocks; austeridad proposals; no direct shock response evidence from AML presidency |
| **5B.10** (durable trajectory vs. inherited) | U0042, U0048, U0063 | **Low** — economic model critique and quantitative targets; biography ends at presidency threshold — no actual trajectory evidence |

### Critical Gap Flag
This CIDOB biography was last updated **29 November 2018** (see U0001, U0066). It does not cover AML's actual presidential term (December 2018 – October 2024). All 5B evidence is **pre-presidency campaign/platform material** or **opposition-period economic critiques of EPN**. There is no evidence of enacted budgets, appointed economic professionals, actual macro-financial rules, shock responses, or post-2018 trajectory outcomes. Any score bearing on 5B must account for this — the source provides program intent and opposition-era policy positions but not implementation evidence. The excluded U0066 explicitly notes "(Cobertura informativa hasta 6/8/2018)" — the biography's own metadata confirmation that the presidential governance period is outside scope.
